Don't let freezing rain catch you off guard! Unlike snow or sleet, freezing rain falls as liquid and freezes on contact. It takes only a thin layer of ice to bring down power lines, snap tree limbs, and turn roads into skating rinks. 🧊 https://t.co/ZhfgI6hVx1

[Winter Preparedness] Freezing rain is one of the most dangerous forms of winter weather. It happens when liquid rain freezes on contact with cold surfaces, creating ice on roads and snapping trees/power lines.

Prep tip: Trim branches, charge devices & stock 1 week of supplies. https://t.co/ACsvxAjLJi
